webSceneNativeScope: HTML Overlays, Resolution Scaling and Hello World native smokes cover the shared globe/projection kernel; their DOM/DPR behavior is browser-only. Offline native smoke loads real local TMS images.
acceptanceScope: All case-specific source statements, inputs, geometry/entities, visibility groups, browser DOM/events/resolution controls and camera behavior in the fixed sources; not a pixel-exact Cesium renderer or implementation of all Viewer widgets.
